# Bismi Boutique

Bismi Boutique is a fashion boutique featuring women's clothing, modest wear and kids' apparel. This website version is a catalogue preview with sample product names, illustrative imagery and demo prices. Confirm all business and product details before launch.

## Website
https://bismiboutique.online/

## Departments
- Women: three-piece sets, two-piece sets, shirts, kurtas, cotton wear, towels, burqa and burqa shawls.
- Kids: girls' co-ord sets, boys' co-ord sets, T-shirts, track pants and socks.

## Preview status
Product images, names and prices are placeholders. Online checkout, payments, newsletter subscriptions, official email and social profiles are not connected. Review the Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, Shipping & Returns and Contact pages before launch.
